items.label: Breaking
items.text: Rapture planner issues revised itinerary after discovering pre-trib, mid-trib, and pan-trib flights all depart from the same gate.

items.label: Developing
items.text: Third Temple fundraising email confirms every donor tier includes a complimentary ‘cornerstone’ you can symbolically touch.

items.label: Update
items.text: Newspaper prophecy study finds today’s headline ‘shocking’ after team highlights every verb in red and whispers ‘there it is’ in unison.

items.label: Report
items.text: Conference speaker unveils ‘this generation’ formula using a whiteboard, a lifespan table, and one very cooperative Greek lexicon.

items.text: Blood moon livestream chat declares the sky ‘definitely different’ while moderators ban anyone mentioning Earth’s shadow.

items.label: Developing
items.text: Antichrist spotters temporarily stand down after realizing the charismatic peacemaker is just a guy trying to merge church calendars.
